lesson.sailboat_scene.title: Sailboat Scene
lesson.sailboat_scene.summary: Construct a sailboat, then use horizon, overlap and scale to place it inside a balanced water scene rather than drawing the boat alone.
lesson.sailboat_scene.step.hull: Start with the hull and a nearby waterline. The boat should feel supported by the water instead of floating in empty space.
lesson.sailboat_scene.help.hull: Keep the hull broad and low. Let the nearby waterline cross the scene around it so the boat has a clear surface.
lesson.sailboat_scene.complete.hull: The hull now sits inside the water rather than on a blank page.
lesson.sailboat_scene.step.sail: Raise the mast and build a large triangular sail around it. Compare the sail height with the hull width.
lesson.sailboat_scene.help.sail: Use the mast as a strong vertical anchor, then let the sail widen as it travels downward.
lesson.sailboat_scene.complete.sail: The mast and sail give the boat a clear scale and direction.
lesson.sailboat_scene.step.depth: Add a horizon and a few water bands. Keep the far marks smaller and closer together so the scene separates foreground from distance.
lesson.sailboat_scene.help.depth: Think in layers: nearby water, middle water, then the horizon. The bands do not need to be perfectly straight.
lesson.sailboat_scene.complete.depth: The water now has foreground and distance instead of one flat strip.
lesson.sailboat_scene.step.balance: Place one small distant island and a sun on opposite areas of the scene. Use their scale and position to balance the larger boat.
lesson.sailboat_scene.help.balance: Keep distant shapes smaller than the boat and avoid crowding every empty space.
lesson.sailboat_scene.complete.balance: The small background anchors balance the main subject without competing with it.
lesson.sailboat_scene.step.make_yours: Finish the scene your way. Add weather, birds, a flag, distant land or remove ideas you do not need. The teacher scene is only one possibility.
lesson.sailboat_scene.help.make_yours: Choose details that support the mood or story. Leave some open space too.
lesson.sailboat_scene.complete.drawing: You built a subject and an environment, then made the final composition your own.
